Subject: Alignment: Implementation commitments & risk mitigation plan

Hi team,

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. To keep momentum with NOVA Systems I've pulled together an initial mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones, owners, and hard dates attached (NOVA_MAP_v1.xlsx).

High-level asks:
- Priyom: confirm who will own the data ingestion milestones (schema handoff + test dataset) and whether we need an additional SE.
- Ben: confirm training session cadence and acceptance criteria for feature parity (demo checklist in the attachment).
- NOVA (Samantha/Tom): review the milestones and call out any constraints (SSO, firewall windows, procurement cutover).

Key risks I flagged in the file:
1) SSO integration timeline (IdP config and cert exchange) — potential 2-week blocker.
2) Test data availability — NOVA needs to provide a sanitized sample by Dec 17 to hit baseline dates.

Proposed near-term milestone summary (from the attachment):
- Dec 20: discovery sign-off (owner: NOVA)
- Jan 6: test dataset delivered (owner: NOVA)
- Jan 14: staging deployment & smoke tests (owner: Redwood)
- Jan 21: training session 1 (owner: Redwood)

Please reply with any schedule conflicts by EOD Friday so I can publish MAP v2.

Thanks,

Olga Petrov
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

A couple notes from NOVA:
- We can commit to providing a sanitized test dataset by Jan 6, but can you confirm data extract format? Our data team prefers a nightly CSV export; is that acceptable?
- SSO: we need a pre-config window with our security team. Can we plan IdP metadata exchange by Dec 22? If not, SSO could block staging until late Jan.
- Training: we'd prefer the first training the week of Jan 18 instead of Jan 14 — several product owners are on leave that week.

If you (Redwood) can shift staging to Jan 15 and training to Jan 19, that would be ideal from our side.
